blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—A lone ticket holder won the ₱94.81 million Lotto 6/42 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draw on Tuesday, Oct. 13, 2026, while the jackpots for Ultra Lotto 6/58 and Super Lotto 6/49 remained unwon. According to the PCSO results provided, the winning Lotto 6/42 combination was 42-05-15-26-19-40, which carried a jackpot of ₱94.81 million. One ticket matched all six numbers. The Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot reached ₱392.06 million, but no ticket matched the winning combination of 35-49-26-12-10-57.
